name: Macrodl
description: Download Geometry Dash macros from Hyperbolus straight from the level page.

format-filter.name: Format filter
format-filter.description: Only macros in these formats are offered for download.

always-confirm.name: Always choose manually
always-confirm.description: Show the macro list even when only one macro matches the format filter.

save-folder.name: Save folder
save-folder.description: Folder where downloaded macros are saved. Leave empty to use the default folder inside the mod's save directory.

existing-file.name: If the file already exists
existing-file.description: What to do when a file with the same name is already in the save folder.
